title: The Little Knight's Gentlest Quest
summary: A little knight-in-training who dreams of big, brave quests gets a new baby sister and discovers that a true knight's most important job is being gentle, quiet and helpful, and that there is plenty of love in the castle for everyone.
character: the little knight-in-training, ONE small boy about five years old with warm deep-brown skin, short curly black hair, big round brown eyes and a gap-toothed smile, wearing a round silver paper-helmet with a small red feather plume on top (face fully visible), a red tunic with a plain golden star on the chest, a short royal-blue cape, brown belt, brown boots, and holding a small wooden toy sword
